summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K disclosing the completion of the sale of its Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) to an undisclosed buyer for $187.5 million in cash, before transaction-related expenses. The PRV was awarded by the FDA upon approval of YUVIWEL (navepegritide) in February 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or additional deal mechanics were named. The transaction was previously announced and has now closed. As a non-US issuer, this 6-K serves as a current report equivalent. The one-time cash inflow boosts liquidity; watch for use of proceeds toward pipeline development or debt reduction. No risk-arb angle as the sale is completed.
